text:
Predicates:
MemberOfPappys(x) ::: x is a member of Pappy's.
StarredIn(x, y) ::: x starred in y.
PilotedIn(y, z) ::: y was piloted in z.
Show(y) ::: y is a show.
OnBBCThree(y) ::: y was on BBC Three.
OnBCBTwo(y) ::: y was on BBC Two.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x was the script editor for y.
Premises:
Badults is a British Sitcom series starring members of Pappy's.
Badults was piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
The working title 'The Secret Dude Society' was used for Badults.
Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
∀x (MemberOfPappys(x) → StarredIn(x, Badults)) ::: All members of Pappy's starred in Badults.
PilotedIn(Badults, July2013) ∧ OnBBCThree(Badults) ::: Badults was piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (MemberOfPappys(x) ∧ (PilotedIn(y, z) ∧ (OnBBCTwo(y) ∨ OnBBCThree(y)))) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three.
